messages:
jordan: Noticed sudden handshake tail after r1234 kernel-selector roll on m10g. p50 same, p95 up ~80ms and occasional decode stalls.

jordan: Quick sampling profile (GPU wall ms):
```
prefill_kernel_select  11.8ms
kv_cache_evict         20.4ms
handshake_block        40.2ms
decode_exec             7.9ms
```

anya: Hmm. Could be kernel tiling mismatch. selector is pushing short prefill batches to gen-optimized kernels; memory layout differs so KV priming suffers.

rav: Proposal: soft-isolate prefill vs decode batch formation. Separate logical queues with token budgets and a small bleed so capacity isn't wasted. In toy cluster it cut handshake tail a lot.

li: Agreed. Also try lengthening kv_priming_window; eviction cadence looks sensitive.

jordan: Local experiment config:
```
{"queues":{
 "prefill":{"token_budget":"56","max_latency_ms":"60","kernel_hint":"prefill_tiling"},
 "decode":{"token_budget":"10","max_latency_ms":"25","kernel_hint":"decode_tiling"}
},
"bleed_percent":"12","kv_priming_window":"4"}
```

li: can you run with kv_priming_window=5 on canary please?

jordan: Ran both 4 and 5. Canary deploy starting.

ops-bot: deploy: canary/eng-runtime/kernel-tiling-isolation-596123 -> us-west1

anya: Benchmark command:
```
./bench/run --profile=handshake --shapes=latency-weighted --duration=6m --concurrency=300
```

jordan: Canary numbers (m10g, us-west1): before: p50 handshake 115ms p95 430ms KV hit 70% ; canary: p50 108ms p95 275ms KV hit 90% ; decode p95 down ~40ms.

rav: Promising. Next run: 12h smoke on dedicated pool, capture kernel heatmap and new metric kernel-migration-rate (evictions/min).

li: If kernel-migration-rate > 15/min we should rollback. Also add a perf CI slow test and a unit test for bleed correctness.

jordan: I'll extend canary, collect heatmaps, and open rollout + rollback runbook (revert r1234 + merge queues). Will post dashboards after 12h.

anya: Low-risk change. Thx team :thumbsup:
